gloss: leaving a job to care for a family member

definitions.gloss: leaving a job to care for a family member; caregiving resignation
definitions.explanation: Quitting one's job because caring for an elderly or ill relative leaves no time to work; discussed in Japan as a social and labor issue.

examples.japanese: {介護離職|かいごりしょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: More people are leaving their jobs to care for family members.

examples.japanese: ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{介護|かいご}→介護：04805_kaigo⟧のために{介護離職|かいごりしょく}した。
examples.english: I quit my job to take care of my mother.

examples.japanese: ⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{介護離職|かいごりしょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧ため、⟦{介護休業|かいごきゅうぎょう}→介護休業：23751_kaigokyuugyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{広|ひろ}げている→広げる：01981_hirogeru⟧。
examples.english: To keep people from quitting work to give care, the government is expanding caregiving leave.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {介護離職|かいごりしょく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to quit one's job to give care
- {介護離職|かいごりしょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧: to prevent caregiving resignations
- {介護離職|かいごりしょく}⟦ゼロ→ゼロ：01011_zero⟧: "zero caregiving resignations" (a government policy slogan)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{介護|かいご}→介護：04805_kaigo⟧: nursing care, caregiving
- ⟦{介護休業|かいごきゅうぎょう}→介護休業：23751_kaigokyuugyou⟧: statutory caregiving leave
- ⟦{離職|りしょく}→離職：16383_rishoku⟧: leaving a job (formal)
